[[Hylas (Factions)|Hylas]] will grant the group access to the [[Unwaking Waters (Luxon)|Unwaking Waters Luxon]] mission outpost, and you will be able to explore the Luxon side without finishing the [[Gyala Hatchery]] mission. * Similarly, if all characters in the party have completed [[Befriending the Kurzicks]], talking to [[Gatekeeper Dedrick]] will give you similar access to the [[Unwaking Waters (Kurzick)|Unwaking Waters Kurzick]] mission outpost, and you can explore the Kurzick side without finishing the [[Eternal Grove]] mission. * Be careful when fighting the Shiro'ken on the way down from Harvest Temple if your faction does not control the single [[resurrection shrine]] in the zone: if your party wipes, you will be returned to the outpost, since there is no place for you to resurrect. * If you are [[Cartographer|cartographing]] the area, you will need to bring a [[shadow step]] skill to gain access to the south-western part of the area. You will have to use it on a Reef Lurker located near the shipwreck that is blocking your path. *{{Vanquisher|count = 146|low = 134|high = 158}} ** There are a few [[Popup|hidden]] pairs of [[Oni]]. ** The shipwrecks or ruined buildings sometimes hide several [[Outcast Assassin]]s. ** You can gain up to 12,000 points of [[Luxon faction]] here, {{2/3}} of which comes from vanquishing, the rest from taking the Luxon bounty); highly efficient teams can do this in about 15 minutes (although most groups will need around 30 minutes). ** Additional foes during [[Outcasts in the Quarry]], which can interfere with vanquishing (see the following bug note). {{bug|Two additional groups of Outcasts will spawn in areas unreachable by foot while Outcasts in the Quarry is active (even though none of the quest objectives take place in Unwaking Waters): one on the path traversed during [[Unwaking Waters|the mission]], the other inside the [[Unwaking Waters (Kurzick)|Kurzick outpost]]. These can be managed by splitting the party on either side of the peninsula or cliff ledge and using non-projectile spells.}} {{bug|Occasionally characters will resurrect at the [[portal]] to the Harvest Temple even after activating the resurrection shrine (via having more unspent faction of their allegiance, killing them or bribing the priest).}} {{Explorable areas in the Jade Sea}} [[Category:Wayfarer's Reverie landmarks]] [[de:Verschlafene Gewässer (Erforschbar)]]
